parameters.sql:
WITH cohort AS (
        SELECT u.user_id, u.registration_os, u.registration_version,
          CASE WHEN CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE) < '2026-01-08' THEN 'previous' ELSE 'current' END AS period,
          CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_id=u.user_id
            AND CAST(s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)=CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)+1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained,
          CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_id=u.user_id AND s.crashed=TRUE
            AND CAST(s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)=CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS crashed
        FROM users u WHERE CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)>='2026-01-01'
          AND CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-15')
        SELECT period, registration_os, registration_version, COUNT(*) AS users,
          SUM(retained) AS retained, SUM(crashed) AS crashed_users,
          SUM(retained)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS retention_rate,
          SUM(crashed)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS crash_rate,
          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-01-01' ELSE '2026-01-08' END AS window_start,
          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-01-08' ELSE '2026-01-15' END AS window_end
        FROM cohort GROUP BY period, registration_os, registration_version
        ORDER BY period, registration_os, registration_version

WITH cohort AS (
        SELECT u.user_id, u.registration_os, u.registration_version,
          CASE WHEN CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE) < '2026-03-10' THEN 'previous' ELSE 'current' END AS period,
          CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_id=u.user_id
            AND CAST(s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)=CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)+1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained,
          CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_id=u.user_id AND s.crashed=TRUE
            AND CAST(s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)=CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS crashed
        FROM users u WHERE CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)>='2026-03-03'
          AND CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-03-17')
        SELECT period, registration_os, registration_version, COUNT(*) AS users,
          SUM(retained) AS retained, SUM(crashed) AS crashed_users,
          SUM(retained)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS retention_rate,
          SUM(crashed)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS crash_rate,
          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-03-03' ELSE '2026-03-10' END AS window_start,
          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-03-10' ELSE '2026-03-17' END AS window_end
        FROM cohort GROUP BY period, registration_os, registration_version
        ORDER BY period, registration_os, registration_version
